prompts.console: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production fantasy MMO bottom HUD console backdrop, 3:1 wide image, transparent background. Create one beautifully hand-painted dark graphite stone and brushed pewter console. Symmetrical broad low architectural silhouette with sculpted beveled corner buttresses, thin ornamental silver metal borders, restrained interwoven knotwork at the corners, a broad recessed nearly-black central basin and a thick sculpted lower lip. Outer corners curl gently upward. The top edge is low and straight so a separate class crest can be placed over it. Almost monochrome silver-gray materials so this console can be tinted per class in an addon. Interior is empty continuous dark stone with extremely subtle texture; leave lots of clear interior room for multiple rows of game buttons and separate menu and bag controls. No internal boxes, no painted buttons, no icons, no lettering, no glyphs, no weapons, no class emblems, no central jewel, no background scene, no drop shadow outside the object. Precise front-facing orthographic game UI artwork, no perspective. Full console visible with small transparent margins, high quality detailed physical materials, clean alpha silhouette. Genuine transparent background outside the console, dark opaque recessed basin inside. Original artwork.
